description: Shared golden fixtures for the FFI protocol. Each case is self-contained: start a fresh session on `document`, apply every command in `setup` (if any), dispatch `command`, then assert. Rust EXECUTES these over the real C ABI in core/tests/contract_fixtures.rs; TypeScript validates the expected shapes against commands.schema.json in app/__tests__/contract.test.ts.

cases.name: word_boundary_moves_highlight
cases.note: Needs a playing session: the snapshot only carries a highlight while playing or paused, so `setup` starts playback first.

cases.name: seek_byte_jumps_to_second_sentence
cases.note: byte 13 falls in 'Bye.' (document 'Hello world. Bye.'); resolves to unit 1. Runs on a fresh session, so the status stays idle.
